name: io.github.chrischall/microsoft-teams-mcp
description: Microsoft Teams for Claude — read your chats, teams, channels, and open messages, via your browser

environmentVariables.name: TEAMS_WS_PORT
environmentVariables.description: fetchproxy concentrator port used for the browser bridge. Defaults to 37149, the fleet-wide shared port.

environmentVariables.name: FETCHPROXY_WS_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Bind interface for the bridge (default 127.0.0.1; a literal IP only, anything else is ignored). Keep on loopback — it exists for ONE topology: a hosted child in its own network namespace.

environmentVariables.name: FETCHPROXY_IDENTITY_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Where to store the long-term fetchproxy identity keypair (default ~/.fetchproxy/identity/; an absolute path only, anything else is ignored). Exists for a host that runs a separate child per caller, so they can share one identity.
